description.value: A Walmart Supercenter (store 1192) in the New Westminster area, offering a broad range of departments including grocery, electronics, clothing, and baby products. As a large-format supercenter, it is one of the more comprehensive resupply stops available to touring cyclists in the region. The grocery section provides access to a wide variety of food and household supplies under one roof.
